Flavio Bolsonaro claims political persecution after fleeing Brazil for US

Flavio Bolsonaro, son of former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro, has stated he left Brazil for the United States due to political persecution. He claims he is a victim of this persecution. Bolsonaro also indicated a potential return to politics, suggesting he might run for president again before 2030.
